flight.lowOrbit: Insufficient delta-v: {haveMs} m/s available, {needMs} m/s required.
orbit.batteryDead: Battery depleted: {haveWh} Wh available, {needWh} Wh required in eclipse.
orbit.insufficientData: Insufficient data delivered: {deliveredMb} Mb delivered, {requiredMb} Mb required.
orbit.insufficientResolution: Insufficient image resolution: {resolutionM} m achieved, {requiredM} m required.
mission.earthObserver.title: Earth Observer
mission.earthObserver.brief: Put an imaging satellite into low Earth orbit and deliver enough data to meet the science team's requirements.
agency.borealis.name: Borealis Federation
agency.borealis.description: Large budget and the full range of launchers. Strong in software and electronics, weak in metallurgy.
agency.monsoon.name: Monsoon Union
agency.monsoon.description: Small budget, cheap launchers and strong software. No heavy launcher.
agency.kestrel.name: Kestrel Republic
agency.kestrel.description: Cheap launchers and strong heavy industry, weaker electronics and optics. Sanctions block the large camera and antenna, so they have to be developed at home.
agency.meridia.name: Meridia Concord
agency.meridia.description: Average budget, very strong optics. Careful development takes longer.
ui.setup.title: Choose the agencies (up to {max})
ui.setup.hint: Agencies take turns at one screen and design their own spacecraft for the same mission.
ui.actionsLeft: {n} controls left to adjust this turn (a control you already touched stays free)
ui.marginHint.dv: Speed change the engine can produce. It must be enough to reach the orbit.
ui.marginHint.energy: The battery must keep the spacecraft alive in the planet's shadow.
ui.marginHint.link: Data you can send down per orbit must cover what the camera collects.
ui.marginHint.science: Smallest visible detail. Smaller is sharper, and science needs at most the required value.
ui.marginHint.mass: The launcher must be able to lift the whole spacecraft with its propellant.
ui.marginHint.budget: Total cost of the spacecraft and the launcher must fit the budget.
ui.waitHint: Waiting makes new modules cheaper, but the deadline gets closer and data from a late launch is worth less.
ui.result.title: Mission results
ui.result.pool: Total paid out: {pool} M$ (variety bonus x{diversity})
ui.result.missed: {agency} missed the deadline and contributed nothing.
ui.dev.title: Develop your own camera
ui.dev.hint: Order a camera with exactly the aperture you need. It costs money now and takes turns, and the factory may deliver a defect that you only see after launch (an inspection lowers the risk).
ui.dev.inspect: Order an inspection (costs more and takes a turn longer)
ui.dev.ready: ready, choose it in the camera slot
design.developed: Developed a custom camera with a {apertureM} m aperture for {costMUsd} M$ over {turns} turns.
design.defect: Production defect: the camera is {blurPercent}% blurrier than designed. It was launched without an inspection, and the risk of a defect was {chancePercent}%.
design.defectInspected: Production defect: the camera is {blurPercent}% blurrier than designed, even though it was inspected. The risk of a defect was {chancePercent}%.
